full_judgment:
4. Defendant No. 1 A.K. Murshed filed an application under Order 7, rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure stating that the suit is barred by the Martial Law Regulation No. 1/82, that the plaint is liable to be rejected, that all issues regarding C.S. plot No. 131 and 132 of of mouza Hajiganj P.S. Fatullah, District Narayanganj have been finally adjudicated upon and decided by Summary Martial Law Court No. 25 at Narayanganj, that the decree passed on 19.3.84 in Martial Law case No. 25/83 and 17/83 was duly confirmed by Zonal Martial Law Administrator, Zone-A, that the judgment and decree was passed by the Martial Law Court on 19.3.84 in presence of all the parties including the plaintiff after hearing the parties, that the said decree is binding on the plaintiff, that the said decree passed in the judgment by the Summary Martial Law Court was cxecuted on 19.4.84 and 20.4.84 through the Deputy Commissioner, that the plaintiff was evicted from the suit land in which he was in wrongful possession, that title of Mir Sayed Ali to .120 acre of land has been established, that .07 acre of land has been found to be Government khas land, that the suit is barred by the principle of res judicata, that the plaint is liable to be rejected for want of cause of action and that the attested photo copy of the judgment and decree of the photostat of the Summary Martial Law Court is attached to the application under Order 7 rule 11 C.P.C. 

 c. rest of the disputed land i.e. .07 decimals should be recorded as Government khas lands."
